summary_en: This study compares soquelitinib, an ITK inhibitor, with standard treatment chosen by the physician (pralatrexate or belinostat) in adults with relapsed or refractory peripheral T-cell lymphoma not otherwise specified, follicular helper T-cell lymphoma, or systemic anaplastic large-cell lymphoma. Soquelitinib 200 mg is taken by mouth twice a day, and standard treatment is given for up to 2 years. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 3 study.
summary_es: Este estudio compara soquelitinib, un inhibidor de ITK, con el tratamiento estándar elegido por el médico (pralatrexato o belinostat) en adultos con linfoma periférico de células T no especificado de otra manera, linfoma de células T folicular auxiliar o linfoma anaplásico sistémico de células grandes en recaída o refractario. Soquelitinib de 200 mg se toma por vía oral dos veces al día, y el tratamiento estándar se administra por hasta 2 años. El resultado principal no se indica; este es un estudio de Fase 3.
who_for: Confirmed PTCL-NOS, follicular helper T-cell lymphoma, or systemic anaplastic large-cell lymphoma.
Progressed on, refractory to, relapsed on, or intolerant to prior therapy; 1 to 3 prior systemic therapies.
FDG-avid disease on PET and measurable disease of at least 1.5 cm on CT.
not_for: T-cell lymphoma with active central nervous system involvement.
Prior administration of an ITK inhibitor.
Known HIV, positive hepatitis B surface antigen, or positive hepatitis C antibody test.
History of allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or those intending to become pregnant during the study.
cancer_types: peripheral t-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified
nodal peripheral t-cell lymphoma with tfh phenotype
